name: Plasma Mortar — slow pulse
notes:
Derived from the revised AI-generated sheet, matching the supplied reference with requested edits. Automatically reduced grid interpretation; small details differ from the reference. Grip/pivot/muzzle are initial estimates requiring rig checks. Preview slot W01 confirmed from repository pixelkit-v2 manifest at ae7247a9b94aeb834342cd40e8aea2eb82308bb8. This does not add firing behaviours.
Revision: weapons-v001. Status: draft. Pixel cleanup and anchor/scale review outstanding. Stored in isolated art/weapon-lab branch.

Pulse-v001: smooth cosine emissive-only loop; 40 frames at 20 fps (2.0 seconds). Original body/trim/guts, dimensions and anchors preserved. No firing trigger; ambient repeating light. Dark trough preserves whatever is painted on the body layer. Draft: in-game recognition and art approval pending.
